verdict: Meta delivering strong leads; Google spend needs immediate correction.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 86 leads at an average cost of $35 per lead — all of them driven by Meta, which delivered at $9.31 per lead on $802 in spend. Google Ads, by contrast, consumed $2,209 this period and recorded zero conversions, confirming a spend leak that is being addressed now by restructuring that campaign's conversion tracking and budget allocation. Separately, 86 leads entered your pipeline this period but zero appointments were booked and no opportunities moved forward, which points to a gap in the intake or follow-up process rather than an ads problem — that workflow is under active review. Ads also went dark for five of the last nine days; the cause has been identified and delivery has been stabilised. Next period you should expect Google waste to reduce, conversion tracking to be fully verified, and the pipeline to begin reflecting actual lead activity.
